workflow.name: validate_request
workflow.purpose: Validate the request before any forecast run or evidence work.
workflow.stopCondition: Stop or revise if the request is rejected, blocked, or canceled.

workflow.name: run_forecast
workflow.purpose: Run the local fixture-safe forecast orchestration for the accepted auto-evidence request.
workflow.stopCondition: Branch on runStatus and error.code before reading downstream outputs.

workflow.name: inspect_intake_outcome
workflow.purpose: Map the forecast-run outcome to an explicit safe next action.
workflow.stopCondition: Do not read forecast outputs for non-completed outcomes.

workflow.name: read_forecast_card
workflow.purpose: Read compact probability, baseline, status, and quality-claim warnings.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation forecast_card --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
workflow.stopCondition: Stop if forecastId or questionId no longer matches the forecast-run summary.

workflow.name: read_evidence_trace
workflow.purpose: Read connector-bound source provenance without raw fixture contents.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation evidence_trace --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
workflow.stopCondition: Do not treat connector trace coverage as all internet evidence.

workflow.name: read_lifecycle_bundle
workflow.purpose: Read audit context, evidence, provenance, resolution, and scoring bindings.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation lifecycle_bundle --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
workflow.stopCondition: Use the bundle for audit context, not as a new source of forecast semantics.

workflow.name: check_resolution_status
workflow.purpose: Confirm whether the forecast is resolved, provisional, ambiguous, or unscorable.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation resolution_status --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
workflow.stopCondition: Do not treat unresolved or unscorable outcomes as normal scored forecasts.

workflow.name: read_scoring_summary
workflow.purpose: Inspect score, baseline comparison, and quality-claim boundary before acting.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation scoring_summary --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
workflow.stopCondition: Do not generalize one fixture score into a live calibration claim.

outcomePlaybooks.agentInstruction: Use forecastCard for compact action context or lifecycleBundle for audit context.
Revise the geography, question text, or source policy before retrying.
Request explicit approval before retrying the forecast run.
Stop; the caller canceled the request before execution.
Use the supported auto-evidence fixture request or wait for broader runtime support.
Retry with a larger maxBytes limit or read smaller operation-specific outputs.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use first for compact action context after a completed forecast run.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation forecast_card --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Do not treat provisional quality claims as calibrated live performance.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use when the caller needs connector-bound source provenance without raw fixture contents.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation evidence_trace --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Do not treat connector trace coverage as all internet evidence.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use when the caller needs evidence, provenance, history, resolution, and scoring context.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation lifecycle_bundle --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Use for audit or explanation, not as a separate forecast source.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use before deciding whether to wait, resolve, score, or report an outcome.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation resolution_status --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Exclude ambiguous, annulled, or unresolved outcomes from normal scoring claims.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use before making baseline-comparison or quality-sensitive downstream decisions.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation scoring_summary --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Report scores with domain, horizon, sample-size, and fixture-mode boundaries.

guards.name: request_result_binding
guards.rule: Carry requestId, forecastId, and questionId from the forecast-run summary into every read.

guards.name: non_completed_no_outputs
guards.rule: Rejected, blocked, canceled, unsupported, and oversized outcomes must not bind forecast outputs.

guards.name: approval_gate
guards.rule: Approval-required requests must ask for approval before retry and must not bypass request policy.

guards.name: local_fixture_boundary
guards.rule: Treat forecast-run as local fixture-safe orchestration, not hosted execution or live internet search.

guards.name: credential_boundary
guards.rule: Never pass secrets, tokens, private data, or credentials in prompt-visible tool arguments.

guards.name: quality_claim_boundary
guards.rule: Report forecast quality with sample-size and fixture-mode warnings until enough outcomes resolve.

commands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-card --id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
commands.expectedSignal: compact forecast card with provisional quality claim

commands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type evidence-trace --id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
commands.expectedSignal: connector-bound evidence trace with source set and result bindings

commands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-bundle --id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
commands.expectedSignal: bound lifecycle bundle with evidence and scoring context

commands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation resolution_status --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
commands.expectedSignal: resolution status envelope bound to the same forecast and question

commands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation scoring_summary --forecast-id forecast-602 --question-id question-601
commands.expectedSignal: scoring summary envelope with baseline comparison boundary

warnings: Runbook describes local CLI and MCP stdio behavior only.
The default forecast-run path is fixture-safe and does not fetch live internet sources.
Non-completed outcomes must not be treated as generated forecasts.
Quality claims remain provisional until enough comparable outcomes resolve.
